newsitem.title: USA: Infinity in pact for $12 mln financing.
newsitem.headline: Infinity in pact for $12 mln financing.

text.p: Infinity Inc said its CIS Oil & Gas Inc subsidiary has signed an agreement which will provide up to $12 million in financing to accelerate the development of CIS' gas properties in the Raton field in southeastern Colorado.

CIS has signed a non-binding letter of understanding for a subsidiary of a global energy company to loan CIS the funds, according to a statement issued by Infinity. The global energy company was not identified.
The agreement requires, among other things, due diligence on the Raton properties and approval by directors of each company, Infinity said.

The Raton properties consist of about 23,000 acres in southeastern Colorado. Infinity said it believes that if the entire $12 million were borrowed, the company would be able to complete the development of the entire property, including up to 130 natural gas wells and the related gas gathering systems.
